title.zh: 谷歌量子芯片新突破：降低关键计算错误率，早期比特币钱包量子风险受关注
title.en: 谷歌量子芯片新突破：降低关键计算错误率，早期比特币钱包量子风险受关注

current_state.zh: Google's Willow quantum chip used a Cultivation method to reduce magic-state preparation errors by roughly 40x while reaching 99.99% fidelity, a research advance that renews attention on the long-term quantum risk to early Bitcoin wallets with exposed public keys.
